```{r, include=FALSE}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(corrplot)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(DHARMa)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(knitr)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(ggeffects)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(glmmTMB)
```


# Read in climate and field data
```{r, include=FALSE}
field_climate_08_23_inc <- read.csv("field_climate_08_23_w18_21_growth_NSavgs.csv", row.names=1, na.strings="NA")%>%
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = (-1*(1 - (SHM/Site_SHM)))*100)%>% #calculate the SHM transfer distance in terms of percent 
  mutate(SHM_mult_dist = round(SHM_mult_dist, digits=3))%>%
  mutate(MAT_dist_sq = MAT_dist^2,
         MAP_dist_sq = MAP_dist^2,
         MCMT_dist_sq = MCMT_dist^2,
         TD_dist_sq = TD_dist^2,
         MSP_dist_sq = MSP_dist^2,
         MWMT_dist_sq = MWMT_dist^2,
         CMD_dist_sq = CMD_dist^2,
         CMI_dist_sq = CMI_dist^2,
         SHM_mult_dist_sq = SHM_mult_dist^2) %>%
  mutate(LD = as.factor(if_else(TS == 1, "L",
                      if_else(TS == 2, "L",
                              if_else(TS == 3, "L","D")))))
field_climate_08_23_inc$Unique_ID <- seq_len(nrow(field_climate_08_23_inc))

field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MCMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MWMT_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MSP_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$TD_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$SHM_dist))
field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist_std <- (field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist - mean(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))/(2*sd(field_climate_08_23_inc$MAT_dist))

live_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>% filter(TS==1|TS==2|TS==3) #7881 live trees assessed

dead_trees <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>%filter(LD=='D')  %>%filter(is.na(PBl)) %>%dplyr::select("Unique_ID","LD")
# 329 dead trees assessed for sunken bole, pitching on bole, galls
```

# Pitching on bole
## Percentiles of interest
0 - 0
0.5x - 5
1x - 10
2x - 21
3x - 31

## Sim 1
```{r,echo=FALSE}
set.seed(25)
#0x - 0 trees
pblrand_0 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=0), ] %>% mutate(pbl_0 = 1)

#0.5x - 83 trees
pblrand_05 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=5), ] %>% mutate(pbl_05 = 1)

#1x - 165 trees
pblrand_1 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=10), ] %>% mutate(pbl_1 = 1)

#2x - 331 trees
pblrand_2 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=21), ] %>% mutate(pbl_2 = 1)

#3x - 496 trees
pblrand_3 <- dead_trees[sample(nrow(dead_trees), size=31), ] %>% mutate(pbl_3 = 1)


pbl_sensDD_join <- left_join(dead_trees,pblrand_0, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,pblrand_05, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,pblrand_1, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,pblrand_2, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,pblrand_3, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) 

pbl_sensDD_repl <- pbl_sensDD_join %>%
  mutate(pblrand_0 = if_else(is.na(pbl_0),0, pbl_0))%>%
  mutate(pblrand_05 = if_else(is.na(pbl_05),0, pbl_05))%>%
  mutate(pblrand_1 = if_else(is.na(pbl_1),0, pbl_1))%>%
  mutate(pblrand_2 = if_else(is.na(pbl_2),0, pbl_2))%>%
  mutate(pblrand_3 = if_else(is.na(pbl_3),0, pbl_3))


tmp_pbl_wDD_sims <- left_join(field_climate_08_23_inc,pbl_sensDD_repl, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(pblrand_0:pblrand_3), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), PBl01, .)))
```

### Standardized variables
```{r, echo=FALSE}
tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$TD_dist_std <- (tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$TD_dist - mean(tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$TD_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$TD_dist))
tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist_std <- (tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist - mean(tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$MWMT_dist))
tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$SHM_dist_std <- (tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$SHM_dist - mean(tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$SHM_dist))/(2*sd(tmp_pbl_wDD_sims$SHM_dist))
```

### Models
```{r, echo=FALSE}
modpbl.OG <- glmmTMB(PBl01 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = field_climate_08_23_inc, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl.DD0xboth<- glmmTMB(PBl01 ~ MWMT_dist +  I(MWMT_dist^2) + SHM_dist + I(SHM_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = field_climate_08_23_inc, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl1.DD0x <- glmmTMB(pblrand_0 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_pbl_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl1.DD05x <- glmmTMB(pblrand_05 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_pbl_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl.DD05xlow <- glmmTMB(pblrand_05 ~ MWMT_dist +  I(MWMT_dist^2) + SHM_dist + I(SHM_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_pbl_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl1.DD1x <- glmmTMB(pblrand_1 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_pbl_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl.DD1xhigh <- glmmTMB(pblrand_1 ~ MWMT_dist +  I(MWMT_dist^2) + SHM_dist + I(SHM_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_pbl_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl1.DD2x <- glmmTMB(pblrand_2 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_pbl_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl.DD2xhigh <- glmmTMB(pblrand_2 ~ MWMT_dist +  I(MWMT_dist^2) + SHM_dist + I(SHM_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_pbl_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl1.DD3x <- glmmTMB(pblrand_3 ~ MWMT_dist_std +  I(MWMT_dist_std^2) + SHM_dist_std + I(SHM_dist_std^2) + TD_dist_std + I(TD_dist_std^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_pbl_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))

modpbl.DD3xhigh <- glmmTMB(pblrand_3 ~ MWMT_dist +  I(MWMT_dist^2) + SHM_dist+ I(SHM_dist^2) + TD_dist + I(TD_dist^2) + (1 | SITE_NAME/BLOCK/PLT) + (1 | REGION),  data = tmp_pbl_wDD_sims, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
```

### Tidy dataframes
```{r,echo=FALSE}
modpblOG_df<-tidy(modpbl.OG, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
modpblOG_df$model <- "OG"
modpblOG_df$multoplier <- "Original model"

sim1pbl0x_df<-tidy(modpbl1.DD0x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1pbl0x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1pbl0x_df$multoplier <- "0"

sim1pbl05x_df<-tidy(modpbl1.DD05x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1pbl05x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1pbl05x_df$multoplier <- "0.5x"

sim1pbl1x_df<-tidy(modpbl1.DD1x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1pbl1x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1pbl1x_df$multoplier <- "1x"

sim1pbl2x_df<-tidy(modpbl1.DD2x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1pbl2x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1pbl2x_df$multoplier <- "2x"

sim1pbl3x_df<-tidy(modpbl1.DD3x, conf.int = TRUE, effects = "fixed")
sim1pbl3x_df$model <- "Sim 1"
sim1pbl3x_df$multoplier <- "3x"
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}

  left_join(.,pbl4rand_3, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) 

pbl_sens4DD_repl <- pbl_sens4DD_join %>%
  mutate(pbl4rand_0 = if_else(is.na(pbl_0),0, pbl_0))%>%
  mutate(pbl4rand_05 = if_else(is.na(pbl_05),0, pbl_05))%>%
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
dead_trees9 <- field_climate_08_23_inc %>%filter(LD=='D') %>%filter(is.na(PBl)) %>%dplyr::select("Unique_ID","LD")
set.seed(38)
#0x - 0 trees
pbl9rand_0 <- dead_trees9[sample(nrow(dead_trees9), size=0), ] %>% mutate(pbl_0 = 1)

#0.5x - 83 trees
pbl9rand_05 <- dead_trees9[sample(nrow(dead_trees9), size=5), ] %>% mutate(pbl_05 = 1)

#1x - 165 trees
pbl9rand_1 <- dead_trees9[sample(nrow(dead_trees9), size=10), ] %>% mutate(pbl_1 = 1)

#2x - 331 trees
pbl9rand_2 <- dead_trees9[sample(nrow(dead_trees9), size=21), ] %>% mutate(pbl_2 = 1)

#3x - 496 trees
pbl9rand_3 <- dead_trees9[sample(nrow(dead_trees9), size=31), ] %>% mutate(pbl_3 = 1)


pbl_sens9DD_join <- left_join(dead_trees9,pbl9rand_0, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,pbl9rand_05, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,pbl9rand_1, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,pbl9rand_2, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) %>%
  left_join(.,pbl9rand_3, by=c("Unique_ID","LD")) 

pbl_sens9DD_repl <- pbl_sens9DD_join %>%
  mutate(pbl9rand_0 = if_else(is.na(pbl_0),0, pbl_0))%>%
  mutate(pbl9rand_05 = if_else(is.na(pbl_05),0, pbl_05))%>%
  mutate(pbl9rand_1 = if_else(is.na(pbl_1),0, pbl_1))%>%
  mutate(pbl9rand_2 = if_else(is.na(pbl_2),0, pbl_2))%>%
  mutate(pbl9rand_3 = if_else(is.na(pbl_3),0, pbl_3))
```

## Coefficient plots
```{r,echo=FALSE}
pblcoefs_ALL <- read.csv("pitchonboleProb_sim_coefs.csv")%>% mutate(term = fct_relevel(term, "(Intercept)", "I(TD_dist_std^2)","TD_dist_std","I(SHM_dist_std^2)","SHM_dist_std","I(MWMT_dist_std^2)","MWMT_dist_std")) %>%
  mutate(multoplier = fct_relevel(multoplier, "0","0.5x","1x","2x","3x", "Original model")) 


pal5_t <- turbo(5, alpha=1, begin=0.2, end=1)
pal6 <- c("#3E9BFEFF", "#46F884FF", "#E1DD37FF", "#F05B12FF", "#7A0403FF","gray")

(coefpbl<- pblcoefs_ALL %>% filter(term !="(Intercept)") %>% 
              ggplot(aes(estimate, term, color=multoplier, xmin=conf.low,xmax = conf.high)) + 
    theme_classic()+
 
    geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")+
      geom_point(aes(color=multoplier),
  fill="black",alpha=0.3,pch=21, position = position_dodge2(.9, padding = .1, reverse=TRUE), stat="identity")  +
   scale_color_manual("Multiplier",values=pal6,labels = c('0x', '0.5x', '1x','2x','3x',"Original model"))+
    geom_vline(xintercept=0,lty=2)+
  labs(x = "Standardized coefficient",y =NULL, title="Probability of pitching on bole")+
   scale_y_discrete(labels = c(expression(paste("TD"^"2")),"TD",expression(paste("SHM"^"2")),"SHM",expression(paste("MWMT"^"2")),"MWMT"))+
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=11),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=11)))
ggsave(coefpbl, file="SSMT_FH_pbl_Sensitivity_coefs_title.png", dpi=600, height=6, width=6)
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
Figpblsensmult <- (ppbl0|plot_spacer())/(ppbl05low|ppbl05high)/(ppbl1low|ppbl1high)/(ppbl2low|ppbl2high)/(ppbl3low|ppbl3high)

ggsave(Figpblsensmultann, file="SSMT_FH_pitchbole_pred_Sensitivity.png", dpi=600, height=10.5, width=7)
```
